utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard any new updates yet, but I’ll keep an eye out while I’m running errands.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Ira. That works for me—just let me know when you hear anything, and I’ll keep the day open.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’m heading out now, so I’ll let you know if I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I’m in—just send me the basics for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great—bring any tools, gloves, and tape if you’ve got them. I’ll send the time and spot next.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it—tools, gloves, and tape. Send the time and spot when you can.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So this repair drive is definitely still happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I think so, but I’d want to confirm the timing and who’s bringing what before we count on it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yeah, fair — can you confirm the timing and who’s bringing what?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — the repair drive. I can help out, I just need the details again.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Oren — we’re gathering tools, spare screws, tape, and any small replacement parts folks can spare. If you can bring what you’ve got, I’ll sort it by need when you arrive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it — I’ll check my toolbox and bring anything useful I can find. See you at the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it — I’ll make sure I have the details straight before we do anything. What should I check first for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Maybe just check what still needs fixing and who’s bringing what—I might be missing a few things too.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll check the list of repairs and the supplies people are bringing, then I’ll compare notes with you.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Jules, sorry I’m late — what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No worries, Dane — we’re still gathering a few last items, and the repair drive is going well so far. If you’ve got anything to drop off, just bring it by and I’ll help sort it out.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, I’ve got a few things I can bring by later today. Just tell me what’s most needed and I’ll swing through.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Could you bring your drill and a few screwdrivers? I’ll sort the tool check-in and show folks where to start.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely—I’ll bring my drill and a few screwdrivers. Just point me to where you want me to start when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I haven’t seen the repair drive start yet, but I’m keeping an eye out for where it’s set up. If you spot any signs or a flyer, let me know and I’ll track it down.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I will — I’m going to check by the school entrance and the community board first.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Good call — those are the most likely spots. I’ll check the park notice board too and let you know if I find it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I heard the repair drive is coming together nicely — folks are really pitching in. If you want, I can keep an ear out for any updates.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Tess — that’d be great. I’ll start spreading the word, and if you hear anything new, let me know right away.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely — I’ll let you know the moment I hear anything new.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How’s the repair drive going, Rey?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: It’s going steady, thanks for asking. I’ve been mostly helping one person at a time, and that seems to be working best.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: That makes sense — how many people do you still need to help?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and keep everyone posted.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — I really appreciate you keeping me in the loop. I’ll help however I can once folks start chiming in.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep spreading the word and let you know as people chime in.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Uli — I’m putting the repair drive details in order now. What’s the first thing you want me to line up?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. If you can line up someone to check the roof first, that would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll line up a roof check first and keep you posted. If there’s a preferred time, send it my way.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I heard the repair drive’s picking up steam—folks are dropping off tools and supplies already. If you’re heading over, I can point you to where they’re sorting everything.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’d be helpful, Tess. I like a clear plan—show me where to bring the tools and I’ll head over.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing — bring them to the sorting table by the community hall entrance, and I’ll walk you over.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late—how’s the repair drive going so far?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No worries—it's going pretty well so far. I'm still coordinating a few things, and I'll keep everyone posted on the next steps.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, thanks for the update—let me know if you need any help with the next steps.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rey. Could you help spread the word and maybe carry a few boxes if you’re free?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Of course — I can spread the word, and I should be able to carry a few boxes too. Just tell me when and where.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what’s the main repair we’re focusing on?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’d focus on the loose front gate at the end of Pine Street first — it’s the one most folks keep mentioning.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’ll start with the loose front gate on Pine Street.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Hana, I’m glad we’re doing the repair drive—it's a nice way to help folks out together. If you want, I can help organize who brings what.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That would be great, Jules — I’d like to check the details first so we stay organized. Can you help make a simple list of who’s bringing what?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll make a simple list and keep it easy to track. Just send me the names and items, and I’ll organize it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Could you bring a box of screwdrivers and any spare extension cords you’ve got? That would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure, I can bring those. I’ll check my garage and grab whatever cords I can find.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, good to hear there’s progress on the repair drive. I’ll keep an ear out for any updates while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Ira — I appreciate that. I’ll let you know as soon as I hear anything new.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good, Gus — I’ll check back in later if I hear anything. Hope the drive gets sorted soon.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great — could you help sort the donated items and set them in the garage?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can sort the donated items and set them in the garage.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m a bit wary about the logistics—who’s bringing the tools, and where should we drop everything off?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good questions — I can bring the tools, and we can drop everything off at the community shed by the park.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That works for me — thanks for handling the tools. I’ll make sure everything gets to the community shed by the park.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m telling a few folks about the repair drive already—want me to add your name and bring you the details?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, please add me—I can help keep track of supplies. Send me the details when you have them.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ll add you for supplies, and I’ll send the details as soon as I get them.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with that—what time does the repair drive need me there, and should I work around pickup?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — I think we’re aiming for around 9, but I should double-check the pickup times. If you can swing by after that, that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sure — just confirm the pickup time and I’ll plan to come by after 9.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll keep things organized and make sure the repair drive is easy for everyone to join.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rosa — I’ve only heard bits and pieces, so that helps a lot. Let me know what I can pass along.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Nell — could you help spread the word that we’re collecting repair requests and volunteer hands this week? I’ll share the details as soon as I have them sorted.
